thread:
maria: Quick heads-up — dropping the weekly KPI snapshot here. noticed a weird spike in webinar signups on Wed that didn't convert to MQLs the same way as prior weeks. dashboard: https://redwood.app/dashboards/weekly-kpi?view=heatmap :eyes:

olivia: I can dig in. are we sure UTM parameters stayed intact on the registration flow? last deploy touched the reg page on Tue.

sam: I saw the spike too. top-line: +42% reg traffic Wed, but MQL rate down ~18%. most of the extra traffic is from organic social (utm_source=twitter) per GA4 quick view.

ethan: dev deploy note — we changed the client-side redirect on the reg widget on Tue to fix an IE bug. shouldn't have stripped utm but possible. i can rollback for a short test. :wrench:

maria: olivia, can you surface the cohort by utm_campaign and utm_content? want to see if a creative variant drove shallow signups.

olivia: pulling a fast SQL now. query: ```SELECT utm_source, utm_campaign, count(1) AS regs, sum(is_mql) AS mqls FROM events.registrations WHERE created_at BETWEEN '2025-06-03' AND '2025-06-09' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY regs DESC LIMIT 50;```

olivia: preliminary: twitter / spring-launch-3 gave 1,240 regs Wed, but mql rate 6% vs baseline 14%. funnel drop at step: email confirmation -> contact form completion.

sam: that points to routing or capture issue. maybe our inbound lead routing dropped some contacts into a bulk queue and didn't enrich. ethan — any recent changes to lead routing webhooks?

ethan: we merged a change to the lead ingestion lambda Friday to add dedupe logic. it flags duplicates by hashed email and can silence webhook delivery for high-volume bursts. i'll check logs for Wed spike window.

maria: can we confirm whether the confirmation email clicks were recorded? if not, the problem might be client-side. if yes, routing.

dashbot: deploy-ops: production deploy 2025-06-02T22:13 by @ethan — changelist: reg-widget redirect fix, lead-ingest dedupe enhancement. no rollbacks.

olivia: email click events look present for ~90% of the cohort, but the contact form POSTs drop dramatically (403s) from a subset of IPs that match our CDN edge A. snippet from logs: ```06-04T10:12:34 POST /api/contact 403 "blocked by waf rule 302"```

sam: ah — WAF false positive for certain social-sourced UTM payloads. maybe the creative includes special chars that trigger the rule.

ethan: i'm disabling the strict WAF rule on a canary edge now, will monitor 15m. if it fixes, we'll whitelist that path and roll a config patch.

maria: awesome. action items: (1) ethan: canary WAF change + report back (2) olivia: validate cohort MQL uplift if canary shows recovery (3) sam: add a note to the launch postmortem about creative encoding + tracking guide. i'll update the KPI board after results. :white_check_mark:

olivia: noted, will post numbers here in ~30m after reprocessing the window.

ethan: canary live, initial 10m looks promising — 403s down ~96% for the affected shard. will keep watching.

sam: if everything holds, can we tweak the dashboard to surface WAF-related contact form failures as a filter? would have saved this triage.

maria: yes — add to backlog. good catch everyone. :clap:

olivia: updated numbers: cohort regs still there, MQL rate recovered from 6% -> 13% after 40m. leaving final verification for EOD but seems resolved.

maria: perfect. i'll mark the KPI alert as "investigated" and schedule a 10m retro tomorrow to tighten the runbook. thanks!
